name: Control Emotions
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of mastering one's emotions, particularly anger, as a mark of true strength and wisdom. Proverbs teaches that patience and self-control surpass even great physical victories, highlighting that ruling over one's spirit is more commendable than conquering a city. Believers are called to exercise discretion by delaying anger and showing grace by overlooking offenses, which brings honor. The fruit of the Spirit—such as love, peace, and longsuffering—enables Christians to live peaceably with others, while prayer acknowledges our dependence on God's power to deliver us from temptation and evil.
